description: Interval MDP, single action; nature splits [0.4,0.6] mass between a reaching state and a dead state.
provenance: Exact O-maximization: pess pushes mass to the dead successor (s1=0.4) => 0.4; opt pushes to the reaching successor (s1=0.6) => 0.6. IntervalMDP.jl robust value interval = [0.4, 0.6].

measured.note: Live peer runs, 2026-06-27 (see TOOL_COMPARISONS.md). PRISM has no interval-MDP support.
